description_short: Cross-link luminescent host materials from the ALD dopant overview (Table 2) with MOSLED performance data (Table 5), listing all recorded performance parameters for materials that appear in both tables.

paper.title: Atomic and Molecular Layer Deposition of Functional Thin Films Based on Rare Earth Elements

tables_modeled.label: Table 2
tables_modeled.description: Overview of rare-earth-doped ALD systems: host materials, dopants or co-dopants, and targeted application domains (e.g., luminescence, memory, gate dielectrics).

tables_modeled.label: Table 5
tables_modeled.description: Performance characteristics of Er3+-based MOSLED devices: annealing temperature, external quantum efficiency (EQE), power efficiency, threshold voltage, emission lifetime (τ), and operational device lifetime (OLT).

join_strategy.description: The query joins Table 2 (doped ALD systems) and Table 5 (Er3+-MOSLED performance) by matching host material labels case-insensitively.
steps: From Table 2 comparison R1469955, retrieve host materials via P180027 and their rdfs:label (?ml).
From Table 5 comparison R1469991, retrieve host matrices via P180031 and their rdfs:label (?ml2).
Apply a case-insensitive equality filter on the string forms of ?ml and ?ml2.
For hosts present in both tables, traverse all literal-valued performance predicates in Table 5.
join_strategy.limitations: The join currently relies on exact string equality (up to case) of labels; hosts with differing spellings or formatting are not matched.

performance_properties.description: The query generically iterates over all literal-valued properties attached to each Table 5 contribution (?c5 ?perf_pred ?perf_val) and excludes rdfs:label. In practice, the relevant predicates for MOSLED performance are P180032–P180037 (annealing, EQE, PE, voltage, τ, OLT).
performance_properties.note: The label ?ppL provides a human-readable description of each performance predicate (e.g. 'external quantum efficiency in %').

dopant_context.description: Dopant information for each host is available in Table 2 via P180028 (dopant / rare-earth ion) and P180029 (application). Although not directly selected in this query, these properties can be retrieved in a follow-up query keyed by the same host label to contextualize MOSLED performance by dopant and application domain.

output_shape.description: Each result row corresponds to one (host material, performance property, performance value) triple. The same host appears in multiple rows, once for each reported performance metric.
columns: ml: host material label (from Table 2, shared with Table 5)
ppL: label of the performance predicate (e.g. EQE, threshold voltage, OLT)
perf_val: literal value of the performance metric

postprocessing_notes.interpretation: The query identifies luminescent host materials that are both (i) doped systems in the ALD overview (Table 2) and (ii) characterized as Er3+ MOSLED hosts (Table 5), then lists all MOSLED performance metrics for those overlaps. This bridges composition-level knowledge (which rare earths are used in which hosts) with device-level figures of merit (EQE, voltage, lifetime), enabling integrated analysis of composition–performance relationships.
